results.title: Chinese driver kills Prachin Buri woman in head-on crash
results.snippet:
Chinese man drives against traffic, kills Prachin Buri woman 

Photo via Channel 7

A Chinese man drove against the flow of traffic and killed a Thai woman in a head-on collision in Prachin Buri in the early hours of Saturday, October 17. Another woman was injured in the crash.

Source: Xinhua
